marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 30 knots diminishing to west 10 to 15 Monday
evening. Showers changing to flurries near midnight and ending near
noon Monday. Temperatures near plus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 early Monday
afternoon.<br/>
